data.title: 毛利兰 · 海浪里的沙滩排球
data.description: 【湘南海岸·盛夏】小兰穿着蓝白运动泳装在沙滩上屈膝接球，身后的遮阳伞和海水被阳光照得发亮；她把球稳稳托起后朝镜头挥手，长发和笑容一起被海风带起。
data.action: 屈膝用并拢的双臂稳稳托起排球，海风扬起长发。
data.lighting: bright summer sun with clean ocean reflections
data.camera: full body, eye level, horizontal framing
data.promptProse: Ran bends her knees beneath the rising volleyball, forearms joined after the pass; sea wind lifts her hair against sparkling water and beach umbrellas.
data.animaCaption: Her joined forearms follow the rising volleyball above her bent knees.
